Drafts: a Philly rates-vs-price fork, a rent-receipts rent-vs-own take, and a 'best window since 2012' local seller angle with the 65% rule.

drafts.draft_en:
Philly investors, quick one.

Same $200k rowhome. Would you rather:

A) the price drops 20%
B) your rate drops 2 points

Assume you have the cash ready. Which one and why?

Education, not advice.
drafts.pattern: Either/or money fork, the same question format behind TheREDevGUY's 341.6k mortgage-income post, localized to a Philly rowhome price. No promised returns.
drafts.video_tip: Talking head, 15s. Split screen with 'A: price -20%' on the left and 'B: rate -2%' on the right; point to each side, then end with 'A or B, tell me in the replies.'

drafts.draft_en:
"Renting is throwing money away."

Five years at $1,500 a month is $90,000 in rent.

But the question isn't rent vs. own. It's what you did with the difference: the down payment you didn't spend, the repairs you didn't pay for, the money you could move.

Renters, owners: who's actually ahead?
drafts.pattern: Rent-vs-own debate with a concrete receipt number ($1,500 x 60 months), riding the rising 'renting is throwing money away' and 'landlord math is thin' threads. Ends on a reply prompt.
drafts.video_tip: Phone on a table: stack sticky notes reading $1,500 while a counter ticks up to $90,000, then cut to you asking the closing question to camera.

drafts.draft_en:
The big funds are calling this the best buying window since 2012.

Here in Philly, that window looks like a tired landlord with below-market rents who's done fixing roofs.

My rule doesn't change with the headlines: purchase plus repairs stays at or under 65% of after-repair value.

And always ask if they'll carry the note.

Build your legacy one deal at a time.
drafts.pattern: Proof-and-timing call (Cardone's 'best buying opportunity since 2012' at 27.7k) brought down to a local tired-landlord seller, plus the below-market-rents puzzle that crossed 10.7k. Uses Bar's stated 65% all-in rule; no promised returns.
drafts.video_tip: Walk-and-talk in front of a Philly rowhome, 20s. Put '65% of ARV' on screen as you say the rule and end on 'ask if they'll carry the note.'
